# Pridatar docs — scoped agent context

> Scoped reference for the documentation area of https://blobs.gay.
> Parent index: https://blobs.gay/llms.txt

## Usage

- Generator source: `src/lib/pridatar/` in https://github.com/Mike-Demo/pride-blobs
- Vanilla: `import { pridatar, pridatarDataUri } from "@/lib/pridatar";`
- React: `<Pridatar name={user.email} size={48} />`
- Shareable URLs: `?seed=demo&flag=rainbow` (params: seed, flag, stripes,
  shape, expression, motion, solid, backdrop, size)

## Flag reference

15 flags: `rainbow`, `progress`, `trans`, `bisexual`, `pansexual`,
`nonbinary`, `lesbian`, `asexual`, `genderqueer`, `genderfluid`, `agender`,
`aromantic`, `intersex`, `demisexual`, `polysexual`. Full stripe tables with
cited notes: https://blobs.gay/docs
